preparation: Windows 1.1.1: extract the complete ZIP, open START-TEST.cmd and click Enter test app. The tester account is provisioned only in the separate test-profile-v1 workspace. The latest Chromebook APK remains 1.1.0+8; enter the actual installed build above.
Use sample data in an empty trial profile for exact balances. Do not reset or overwrite real business data.
Export a business backup before testing. Keep it off the device.
Windows test access is documented in WINDOWS_TEST_LOGIN.md. For business/Android profiles create your own local owner password; never put private credentials in results.
Use English labels for the walkthrough, then repeat the language/layout checks in Arabic.

Run the exact base cycle in this order: TC-070, TC-034, TC-039, TC-040, TC-048, TC-050, TC-058, TC-060, TC-061, TC-071. Check the USD 90 cash and stock totals before running the refund/return chain TC-065, TC-066 and TC-068.

Use separate trial items/documents for other mutation and rejection tests so they do not alter the base cycle. Category/ID order is a catalog, not an instruction to run every case against the same records.
The Chromebook APK is debug-signed for development testing. Play Store publication needs an owner-approved application ID, release signing and Play Console access.
For warehouse1.1 examples use a separate empty SKU/dataset. Manufacturing must precede trading in the mixed-source FIFO example. See WAREHOUSE_UPGRADE_GUIDE_AR.md.

cases.title: Windows complete folder
steps: Extract the full Windows ZIP
Launch detergent_factory.exe with its DLLs and data folder beside it
cases.expected: App opens without missing-runtime errors. Existing data remains in its original location.

cases.title: First launch and restart
steps: On an empty trial profile create an owner account
Close and reopen the app
Sign in again
cases.expected: Account persists and sign-in reaches language selection and the dashboard.

cases.title: Duplicate Windows launch
steps: Open the Windows executable again while it is running
cases.expected: The existing window is brought forward. A second process does not open the same database.

cases.title: Offline operation
steps: Disconnect the device from the internet
Open existing data and create a sample transaction
cases.expected: Local sign-in, stock and documents work without a server. No cloud sync is implied.

cases.title: Storage failure guidance
steps: If a data-open/lock error occurs record its exact message
Close duplicate processes and retry without deleting files
cases.expected: Actionable recovery guidance is shown; existing data is preserved.

cases.title: Supported Android environment
steps: Confirm Google Play Store/Android support on the Chromebook
Follow CHROMEBOOK_GUIDE.md for an approved APK installation route
cases.expected: Android app runs as an installed ChromeOS application. The Windows EXE is not used.

cases.title: Test APK identity
steps: Inspect the APK name/version and installation source
Treat it as a debug-signed test build
cases.expected: Version is 1.1.0, build 8. It is not presented as a production Play Store release.

cases.title: Laptop without touch
steps: Use keyboard, trackpad and mouse to sign in and navigate
cases.expected: No touchscreen is required; interactive controls work with pointer input.

cases.title: Window resizing
steps: Resize to a narrow window, a large window and maximized mode
cases.expected: Content reflows, remains scrollable and does not lose saved records or drafts.

cases.title: Physical numeric keyboard
steps: In a narrow ChromeOS window type and delete numeric values
Type Arabic decimal digits
Clear a value
cases.expected: Native editing works, Arabic decimals normalize correctly and clearing does not retain stale positive values.

cases.title: Optional touch keypad
steps: Open the numeric keypad icon
Enter a decimal
Confirm
cases.expected: The optional keypad works and does not alter an Arabic decimal to zero.

cases.title: Suspend and resume

cases.expected: Saved drafts and posted data remain intact. Unsaved editor text is not represented as a posted transaction.

cases.title: Owner enrollment validation

Try blank username and a password shorter than 12 characters
Enter valid owner details
cases.expected: Invalid enrollment is blocked with guidance; valid setup signs in without a default password.

cases.title: Editing credentials

Toggle password visibility in the in-app editor
cases.expected: Deleted letters do not reappear. Visible values match the submitted values.

cases.title: Windows native dialog
steps: Use Enter credentials and sign in
Cancel the dialog once
Reopen and enter local ERP credentials
cases.expected: Cancel changes nothing. Local ERP credentials work; Windows account credentials are not required.

cases.title: Wrong credentials
steps: Try an incorrect password for a secondary test account
cases.expected: Access is rejected. No business route becomes accessible.

cases.title: Temporary lockout
steps: Use a secondary disposable test account
Submit five wrong passwords
Retry immediately then after five minutes or an owner reset
cases.expected: The immediate retry is locked; recovery works through the supported owner/reset or time window.

cases.title: Owner creates roles
steps: Create manager, accountant, warehouse, cashier and viewer test users
cases.expected: Users persist with their selected roles and active state.

cases.title: Viewer posting limits and shared estimates
steps: Sign in as viewer
Attempt a stock posting, sale, financial journal and restore

Open Production costing as viewer and inspect draft editing separately from posted stock/finance. Current estimate drafts are shared locally and their fields are not gated by posting permissions; record this limitation rather than assuming fully read-only access.
cases.expected: All prohibited mutations are rejected; data and audit history remain unchanged. Costing estimate drafts currently remain editable by signed-in roles, including viewer; this limitation is listed in remaining scope and does not authorize posting stock or journals.

cases.title: Warehouse approval rejected
steps: As warehouse staff plan an order then try to approve it
cases.expected: Warehouse posting is allowed; approval is rejected until performed by manager/owner.

cases.title: Cashier financial limits
steps: As cashier sell and allocate a customer payment
Try a manual journal or stock adjustment

cases.title: Period reopening limits
steps: As accountant or manager try reopening a closed period
Repeat as owner with a reason
cases.expected: Only the owner can reopen it; reason and actor remain recorded.

cases.title: Last owner protection
steps: With only one active owner try deactivating or demoting that account
cases.expected: The app preserves at least one active owner.

cases.title: Inactive user
steps: Deactivate a secondary user
Try signing in as that user
cases.expected: Inactive account cannot sign in. Its earlier posted history remains.

cases.title: Logout isolation
steps: Sign out while on a business screen
Try Back navigation
Sign in again
cases.expected: Business routes disappear; re-entry requires authentication and reaches a fresh route tree.

cases.title: Currency separation
steps: Post trial documents in USD and SYP
Change overview currency
cases.expected: Only the selected currency enters sales/balance/cash totals; no implicit conversion is performed.

cases.title: Document balances
steps: Complete the sample business cycle below
Compare dashboard customer/supplier balances with Finance
cases.expected: Balances agree with active documents after payments and refunds.

cases.title: Approval and quality queues
steps: Create a draft production order
Approve it
Release it
cases.expected: Dashboard queue counts move from approval to quality release and then clear for that order.

cases.title: Recent documents
steps: Post a purchase and a sale
Click each entry under Recent documents
cases.expected: Newest records show their own currency and open the relevant document tab.

cases.title: Grouped modules
steps: Open every dashboard module and return
cases.expected: Warehouse, operations, transfers, sales, parties, costing, documents, finance and authorized administration routes work.

cases.title: Loading and empty states
steps: Open an empty trial dataset
Observe startup/loading and recent documents
cases.expected: Unloaded data is not presented as confirmed zero balances. Empty history offers useful guidance.

cases.title: English and Arabic
steps: Switch languages
Repeat navigation, dialogs and numeric entry
cases.expected: Labels, RTL alignment, Cairo glyphs and values remain readable and consistent.

cases.title: Large text and display scaling
steps: Increase system text/display scale
Resize the app
Scroll long forms and reports
cases.expected: Controls remain reachable; essential content is not clipped or hidden behind the app bar.

cases.title: Create and reopen records
steps: Create Sample supplier and Sample customer with phone/address
Restart
cases.expected: Contact data and stable records persist.

cases.title: Duplicate master names
steps: Try creating a duplicate name in the same role
cases.expected: Duplicate is rejected; existing contact remains intact.

cases.title: Rename preserves documents
steps: Post a linked document then rename its contact
cases.expected: Posted document retains the name snapshot and party ID; contact balances remain linked.

cases.title: Deactivate contact
steps: Deactivate a contact
Open a new trade form
Inspect earlier documents
cases.expected: Inactive contact cannot be selected for a new linked posting; old history remains readable.

cases.title: Outstanding contact balance
steps: Post partial-payment documents for the sample customer/supplier
Allocate later payments
cases.expected: Outstanding balances update by currency and never guess links from free-text names.

cases.title: Multi-line receipt
steps: Select Sample supplier
Receive Water 100 Kilogram at USD 1 and Fragrance 10 Kilogram at USD 5
Pay USD 30 initially
cases.expected: Receipt total is USD 150, payable USD 120. Both stock lines increase once.

cases.title: Supplier settlement
steps: Allocate USD 120 against that receipt
Inspect document and supplier balance
cases.expected: Payable becomes zero; original receipt content remains immutable and payment history is retained.

cases.title: Retry idempotency
steps: While a form is saving try submitting again
After an interrupted/retried posting inspect stock and document history
cases.expected: A repeated request cannot double stock or create duplicate numbered documents.

cases.title: Invalid quantity and price
steps: Try zero/negative or malformed quantity and unsupported decimal precision in a receipt
cases.expected: Invalid posting is rejected; no partial stock/documents/journals remain.

cases.title: Unit mismatch atomicity
steps: Create a multi-line receipt where one existing material uses an inconsistent unit
cases.expected: Whole receipt fails atomically. Other valid lines do not change stock.

cases.title: Purchase return after use
steps: Consume some received material in production
Try returning the full receipt
cases.expected: Return is blocked if remaining stock is insufficient.

cases.title: Paid purchase return
steps: Try reversing a paid purchase
Obtain/record an actual supplier refund then retry with enough stock
cases.expected: Paid reversal is blocked until net paid amount is zero. Refunds and return retain source links.

cases.title: Raw stock count
steps: Count a separate trial material to a different actual quantity with a reason
cases.expected: Recorded count and stock movement agree; before/after quantity and actor persist.

cases.title: Zero stock count
steps: Count a separate trial item to 0.00
Try a negative target
cases.expected: Zero is accepted; negative target is rejected.

cases.title: Plan versioned recipe
steps: Plan Cleaner output 10 Kilogram, lot TEST-001, Water 9 and Fragrance 1
cases.expected: Draft order links material IDs and a recipe snapshot. Raw stock is not consumed by planning.

cases.title: Unique lot and valid expiry
steps: Try reusing TEST-001
Try an invalid expiry date
cases.expected: Duplicate lot and invalid date are rejected without a partial order.

cases.title: Approval and release
steps: Approve the Cleaner order as manager with a note
Release with a successful quality check and note
cases.expected: Order becomes released. Water stock is 91 and Fragrance 9 after the sample receipt above.

cases.title: Quality check required
steps: Leave the QC checkbox unchecked or the quality note blank
cases.expected: Release is blocked; stock and order history remain unchanged.

cases.title: Insufficient materials
steps: Approve an order whose ingredients exceed available stock
Attempt release
cases.expected: No partial consumption/output posts; order can be reviewed without corrupted stock.

cases.title: Recipe revision
steps: Change ingredient quantities/output and plan a new order for the same product
cases.expected: A new recipe version is retained. Earlier order snapshots are not rewritten.

cases.title: Expiry control
steps: Use an already expired production lot and attempt quality release/transfer
cases.expected: Expired output is blocked by the supported expiry checks.

cases.title: Cancel unposted order
steps: Cancel a draft/approved order with a reason
cases.expected: Cancellation event remains visible; raw stock is not consumed.

cases.title: Immutable production correction
steps: Reverse/correct a production record with a reason
cases.expected: Original number/content and reversal/correction links remain; stock effects happen once.

cases.title: Reversal while output transferred
steps: Transfer output away then try reversing the batch
cases.expected: Reversal is blocked until outstanding finished-goods transfers are returned.

cases.title: Explicit packaging conversion
steps: Transfer the complete 10 Kilogram Cleaner batch to 20 Piece Cleaner bottle, reference price USD 10
cases.expected: Untransferred batch quantity becomes zero; shop stock becomes 20; transfer retains TEST-001 and explicit conversion.

cases.title: Transfer availability
steps: Try transferring more output than remains or a mismatched source unit
cases.expected: Posting is rejected without changing either store.

cases.title: Customer sale
steps: Sell 4 Cleaner bottle at USD 10 to Sample customer
Receive USD 10 initially
cases.expected: Sale total USD 40, receivable USD 30 and stock 16. The sale retains allocated lot references.

cases.title: Customer settlement
steps: Record USD 30 against the sale
cases.expected: Receivable becomes zero and payment allocation persists.

cases.title: Overpayment and refund limit
steps: Try paying beyond the balance
Try refunding beyond net paid amount
cases.expected: Both invalid amounts are rejected; no new allocation/journal is posted.

cases.title: Multi-item sale atomicity
steps: Sell two products with insufficient stock in one line
cases.expected: Whole sale is rejected; the sufficient line is not decremented.

cases.title: FIFO and expired lots
steps: Create two transfer lots for a separate sample SKU
Sell stock
Include an expired remaining lot
cases.expected: Allocation uses available eligible lots by FIFO and does not sell expired stock.

cases.title: Paid sale reversal
steps: Try reversing the paid USD 40 sale before refunding
cases.expected: Reversal is rejected until actual money is refunded and net paid becomes zero.

cases.title: Refund and full sales return
steps: Record an actual USD 40 customer refund with reason
Reverse the full sale
cases.expected: Stock returns to 20; receivable is zero after the return; original sale and refund remain in history.

cases.title: Transferred lot return restriction
steps: Try returning a lot whose units are already sold or removed by a stock count
cases.expected: Return is blocked until the entire required lot stock is genuinely available; unrelated stock cannot substitute for it.

cases.title: Reverse complete chain
steps: After returning the sale, return the transfer
Reverse production
Record actual USD 150 supplier refund
Reverse the purchase
cases.expected: Sample raw/shop stocks end at zero. All original, refund and reversal records remain. Opening cash returns to its initial amount.

cases.title: Physical shop count
steps: Reduce a separate sample shop item's count with a reason
Inspect lot availability
cases.expected: Physical stock/count history agree. Negative counts reduce available lots; financial valuation is reviewed separately.

cases.title: Reviewed opening cash
steps: In an empty trial dataset post USD 200 debit 1000 Cash / credit 3000 Equity
cases.expected: Opening journal balances; ledger cash is USD 200.

cases.title: Purchase-to-cash reconciliation
steps: Use the sample purchase, supplier payment, production, transfer, sale and customer payment
cases.expected: After all payments, cash is USD 90, receivables USD 0 and payables USD 0. Stock is Water 91, Fragrance 9 and bottles 16.

cases.title: Every journal balances
steps: Inspect purchase, sale, payment, refund, reversal and manual journal records
cases.expected: Debits equal credits per currency, sources and actors are retained, trial difference is zero.

cases.title: Manual reconciliation difference
steps: In a trial dataset add USD 1 debit Receivables / credit Equity without allocating a document
cases.expected: Trial balance can still be zero, but document reconciliation shows the USD 1 difference for review.

cases.title: Currency control accounts
steps: Post a separate SYP opening/journal
Inspect USD and SYP summaries
cases.expected: Currencies stay independent; balances are never combined without an explicit policy.

cases.title: Close accounting period
steps: Close through the date supported by Finance with a reason
Try a new posting in that period
cases.expected: Posting is blocked in both stores and closure is persisted/audited.

cases.title: Owner reopening
steps: Reopen as owner with a reason
Retry a valid trial posting
cases.expected: Posting becomes available; reopening event retains actor/reason.

cases.title: No false profit claim
steps: Inspect finance/dashboard after manufacturing and sales
cases.expected: The app presents cash, balances and journals, without implying automatic inventory valuation, COGS or a complete profit statement.

cases.title: Restore costing inputs
steps: Save product name, output and ingredients
Leave the costing workspace and return
Restart
cases.expected: Draft data reloads, including the visible product name.

cases.title: Base material estimate
steps: Set output 10 kg
Enter 2 kg concentrate at USD 10/kg
cases.expected: Material estimate is USD 20 and product cost is USD 2/kg before extra batch charges.

cases.title: Labor and overhead
steps: Enter batch labor USD 5 and overhead USD 3
cases.expected: Total batch estimate becomes USD 28 and cost per good-output kilogram USD 2.80; breakdown shows all three components.

cases.title: Measured volume fill
steps: Set 500 ml, density 1.2 kg/L, container USD 0.20 and label USD 0.10
cases.expected: Fill mass is 0.6 kg; with the USD 2.80/kg batch estimate bottle cost is USD 1.98.

cases.title: Carton costing
steps: Set 6 bottles/carton and empty carton USD 0.60
cases.expected: Using the example above carton estimate is USD 12.48.

cases.title: Mass versus volume
steps: Compare 500 g and 500 ml at density 1.2
cases.expected: Mass is 0.5 kg for grams and 0.6 kg for millilitres; displayed unit and estimates differ correctly.

cases.title: Missing density
steps: Select ml/L and leave density zero
cases.expected: Cost report is blocked with guidance; no implicit 1 kg/L density is assumed.

cases.title: Legacy unit confirmation
steps: Load an old v1 packaging draft
Confirm grams or choose the correct unit
cases.expected: Values are preserved, but unconfirmed legacy sizes cannot silently produce a report.

cases.title: Unconfigured exchange rate
steps: Leave exchange rate at zero
Inspect SYP price fields/results
cases.expected: SYP conversion editing is disabled and reports show unavailable amounts rather than a misleading converted zero.

cases.title: Configured exchange rate
steps: Set rate 100 for the USD 28 batch
cases.expected: SYP total is 2800 and per-kg estimate 280; underlying posted ledger currencies are not converted.

cases.title: Yield sensitivity
steps: Change good output from 10 kg to 8 kg while expenses remain USD 28
cases.expected: Cost per kg rises from USD 2.80 to USD 3.50; batch cost remains USD 28.

cases.title: Incomplete/overflow input
steps: Leave missing names, zero output or zero fill size
Try out-of-range amounts
cases.expected: Report shows input/range guidance rather than invalid zero/infinite totals.

cases.title: Draft charges are estimates
steps: Compare Finance before/after changing labor, overhead and packaging estimates
cases.expected: Costing edits do not post payroll, cash, stock valuation or financial journals.

cases.title: Document search and lines
steps: Search by number, contact and item
Open multi-line purchase/sale details
cases.expected: Matching records and every line are visible; values and actors match the posting snapshots.

cases.title: Document PDF
steps: Generate a sale PDF after later payments/refunds
Save or print
cases.expected: Totals, currency, allocation history and balance are correct. It does not invent tax configuration.

cases.title: Bilingual cost PDF
steps: Generate the costing example in English and Arabic
cases.expected: Cairo text and RTL are readable; fill units, density and raw/labor/overhead costs match the screen.

cases.title: Physical printing
steps: Print a document on the actual device/printer
cases.expected: No clipped essential content; numbers and glyphs are readable. Record printer/device details and any failure.

cases.title: Verified backup creation
steps: Create a backup
Copy/export it off the device
Read the returned completion message
cases.expected: Validated business data and costing drafts are preserved with checksum/version information.

cases.title: Restore cancellation
steps: Select valid backup text/file
Cancel the confirmation
cases.expected: Current data does not change and no replacement is performed.

cases.title: Valid restore
steps: In a trial dataset save a backup then change sample data
Restore with owner confirmation
cases.expected: A safety backup is preserved first; restored stock, history, payments, recipes, periods and drafts agree with the snapshot.

cases.title: Corrupt backup rejection
steps: Alter backup text or its checksum
Attempt validation/restore
cases.expected: Corrupt payload is rejected before overwrite; current business state remains intact.

cases.title: Cross-device business transfer
steps: Copy backup text from Windows to Chromebook
Use a separately enrolled local owner on the destination to restore
cases.expected: Business data transfers without live synchronization. Local account credentials do not transfer with the business backup.

cases.title: Interrupted recovery
steps: Advanced controlled recovery check: use a disposable copied test environment with a verified backup and developer assistance. If this cannot be exercised, mark Blocked rather than guessing Pass. Never interrupt or edit the live business database.
On a trial device interrupt a restore/paired transfer then reopen
Follow recovery guidance
cases.expected: Pending journal is replayed/retried before normal posting. Do not delete lock/database files as a workaround.

cases.title: Audit preservation
steps: Inspect original records after corrections, counts, refunds, returns and master edits
cases.expected: Original numbered business content and audit links are retained; there is no destructive history reset.

cases.title: Legacy stock migration
steps: Upgrade a COPY of old business data. Compare raw/finished balances, original document IDs, payments and journals. Restart twice.
cases.expected: Balances and history are preserved; migration does not receive all old production again. Unknown source/cost remains explicitly unknown.

cases.title: Register one finished SKU
steps: Register Cleaner 1L with SKU CL-1L, base unit Package, and no opening quantity.
cases.expected: One product with zero stock exists; no supplier purchase or manufacturing document is invented.

cases.title: Product-specific carton definitions
steps: For CL-1L define Carton = 12 Package. For a different SKU define Carton = 24 Package.
cases.expected: Each product retains its own positive conversion and revision; factors do not leak across SKUs.

cases.title: Raw mass conversion
steps: For raw Powder with base Kilogram, receive 500 Gram at USD 0.01 per gram.
cases.expected: Raw stock increases 0.5 kg. Supplier invoice remains 500 grams, total USD 5.00, with a frozen conversion.

cases.title: Direct trading receipt
steps: Buy 3 Carton of CL-1L at USD 36 per carton through Trading purchase.
cases.expected: Finished stock increases 36 Package, receipt total USD 108; raw stock and production orders do not change.

cases.title: Manufacturing automatic receipt
steps: Plan 24 Package, approve, then Complete & receive finished goods. Select the same CL-1L SKU, actual ingredient usage and 24 output, check QC and enter total confirmed cost USD 48 with a reviewed reference.
cases.expected: Actual raw consumption, batch and 24 ready packages commit together once, with manufacturing lot and cost snapshot. Mere planning approval does not receive sale stock.

cases.title: Mixed-source sale
steps: On an empty trial SKU run manufacturing receipt BEFORE the trading receipt above. Sell 30 Package at USD 4.
cases.expected: One SKU starts at 60. Sale allocates 24 manufactured and 6 supplier packages, allocated cost USD 66; remaining finished stock is 30 supplier packages.

cases.title: Carton sale
steps: On separate trial stock buy 24 Package with Carton = 12. Sell 1 Carton at the explicit carton selling price.
cases.expected: Invoice records 1 Carton, stock decreases 12 Package, and lot allocations cover all 12 base units.

cases.title: Changed carton after receipt
steps: Receive stock with factor12, revise carton factor to24, then view old receipt and post a new transaction.
cases.expected: Historical invoice and stock quantity remain unchanged. New transactions freeze revision2 and factor24.

cases.title: Actual production variance
steps: Complete an approved trial order using a different positive actual output or actual ingredient quantity; first omit, then enter the variance reason.
cases.expected: Missing reason is rejected. Valid completion preserves the original planned recipe alongside actual values and rejects shortages atomically.

cases.title: QC and output unit control
steps: Attempt completion without QC or with an unrelated finished SKU unit.
cases.expected: No ready stock or partial consumption is posted. Bulk-to-package conversion is not guessed.

cases.title: Bulk packaging receipt
steps: Use the bulk release/later transfer route. Select an existing finished SKU, enter measured source/output quantities and units, and optionally enter a separate reviewed total lot cost/currency.
cases.expected: The selected SKU receives one manufacturing lot, source quantity is conserved, and cost stays separate from the selling reference price.

cases.title: Supplier lot return restriction
steps: Sell some units from supplier receipt A, replenish from receipt B, then attempt to return all of A.
cases.expected: Return is rejected until A original lot is genuinely available; unrelated replenishment cannot replace it.

cases.title: Return exact source costs
steps: Post two sales from one trial costed lot, then return the earlier sale.
cases.expected: Original sale allocations and minor-unit costs are reversed exactly. Exhausting the lot later leaves zero quantity and no residual allocated cost.

cases.title: Warehouse document filters
steps: Open Purchases and filter Raw materials / Trading goods. Open Sales and filter Manufacturing / Supplier purchases / Opening or Adjustment.
cases.expected: Only matching documents are shown; stock quantity conversion and per-lot allocated cost/source remain visible.

cases.title: Unknown cost and currencies
steps: Inspect old opening stock, a USD supplier lot and a separate SYP supplier lot.
cases.expected: Unknown is not displayed as zero cost; original lot costs retain their currencies and are not summed into a false combined valuation.

cases.title: Upgrade and paired-write recovery
steps: Advanced controlled recovery check: use a disposable copied test environment with a verified backup and developer assistance. If this cannot be exercised, mark Blocked rather than guessing Pass. Never interrupt or edit the live business database.
On disposable trial copies interrupt migration or a coordinated trading/production posting and restart. Preserve backups and files.
cases.expected: Pending recovery finishes both snapshots once before posting resumes. Inconsistent candidates fail before overwriting original data.

steps: In the bulk transfer dialog enter the actual source quantity before selecting an existing finished SKU. Select that SKU, delete/retype quantity digits, then cancel. Repeat in Arabic and English.
cases.expected: The visible quantity remains the entered quantity during layout changes; deleted digits do not return. Cancellation changes no raw or finished stock.

cases.title: One-click Windows trial login
steps: Extract the complete 1.1.1 Windows ZIP
Open START-TEST.cmd
Click Enter test app, then choose a language
cases.expected: The real ERP dashboard opens without typing or a Windows credential prompt. The amber test banner stays visible.
